about:
Sportex Apparel, based in Tempe, Arizona, was founded in 1988 as Sportex Safety & Ad-Vantage Marketing. The company began with a focus on designing, manufacturing, and decorating high-visibility workwear, general personal protective equipment, and safety incentive products.

Today the operation runs multiple decoration and manufacturing services under one roof, including screen printing with plastisol and water-based inks, embroidery, cut-and-sew, laser engraving, pad printing, sublimation, offset, digital, and large-format printing. The company also handles product development for custom sportswear replica jerseys, safety apparel, and full product lines, offering inventory management, e-commerce, and custom webstore fulfillment. Its brand family spans Sportex Safety, Sportex Athletics, the collegiate line Raise the Roof, Ad-Vantage Marketing for promotional products, and the resort-apparel labels Brieland Graphics, Copper Canyon Artworks, and Maiden West.

Customers come from industrial safety programs, athletic teams, collegiate licensing, resort retail, and promotional-product distributors. Examples include businesses ordering custom high-visibility workwear, schools and fans purchasing licensed replica jerseys, and resorts stocking embellished fashion garments with foil, rhinestone, or embroidery details.

The company emphasizes domestic production—“USA made.. IT MATTERS”—and aims to deliver custom projects in two to three weeks from discovery call to final delivery. It provides complimentary proposals and art proofs, supported by an in-house art team, and promotes a no-obligation approach to new opportunities.
